name: Whetstone
desc: Swords deal +1 damage.
flavor: The blade remembers every stone.

name: Bulwark Sigil
desc: Shields give +1 block each.
flavor: A promise carved in iron.

name: Leech Flask
desc: Potions heal +1 extra.
flavor: It bites back, but only a little.

name: Gilded Reel
desc: Coins pay out +1 extra each.
flavor: The house always takes its cut. Now you do too.

name: Bone Ward
desc: Skulls add only +1 damage instead of +2.
flavor: The dead nod to their own.

name: Iron Frame
desc: Start every fight with 4 block.
flavor: The machine was built to take a beating.

name: Lucky Coin
desc: Coins pay out +1 extra each.
flavor: It lands on its edge every time.

name: Thick Hide
desc: Start every fight with 3 block.
flavor: Scar tissue, but make it fashion.

name: Potion Belt
desc: Potions heal +1 extra.
flavor: One for the road. Two, actually.

name: Sharp Teeth
desc: Swords deal +1 damage.
flavor: You bite back now.

name: Second Wind
desc: Once per run: survive lethal damage and return with 8 HP.
flavor: Death checks the machine. It does not check twice.

name: Lucky Seventh
desc: Every 7th pull rigs the reels to show at least 2 swords.
flavor: Seven is not a lucky number here. It is a promise.

name: Bloodstone
desc: Gain 1 coin for each point of damage you take.
flavor: Pain is just a deposit.

name: Skull Crown
desc: Each skull also deals 1 damage to the enemy.
flavor: Wear the thing that wants to eat you.

name: Gambler's Eye
desc: The first skull each fight adds no damage.
flavor: You saw it coming. You always do.

name: Deep Pockets
desc: You can carry 1 more relic.
flavor: The grave has room for more.

name: Vampiric Edge
desc: Heal 1 HP when you slay an enemy.
flavor: Every grave feeds you a little.

name: Grave Pact
desc: Swords deal +2 damage. Max HP -8 when taken.
flavor: Sign here. The ink is already warm.

name: Dead Man's Hand
desc: A payline of three swords deals +6 bonus damage.
flavor: Three blades. No bluff.

name: House Edge
desc: Every payout +1. Max HP -6 when taken.
flavor: The house always wins. Tonight, so do you.
